accessToken.description: OIDC access token from the identity provider

providerCode.description: Configured provider code when multiple IdPs are enabled

clientId.description: Service client identifier (service identity display name)

revoked.description: Always true once the current session is revoked

revokedCount.description: Number of sessions revoked for the current user account

forbiddenParticipantFields.description: Participant fields that public discovery never exposes

verificationReference.description: Where the verified, executed copy is held (gazette reference, registry entry, file number)

actorIdentityId.description: Ignored — administrator identity is derived from the authenticated session

caseId.description: Case context for server-derived evidence, conflict, and SoD facts.

evidencePacketVersionId.description: Evidence packet version used to resolve evidence completeness server-side.

decisionReadinessAssessmentId.description: Decision readiness assessment used to resolve approvals and conflict state.

status.description: Phase 4F structured status derived from outcome and explanation codes. Not a universal permission.

publicStatusLabel.description: Omitted when no status projection exists

profileNumber.description: Omitted when the citizen has no healthcare profile

personId.description: Link or update the associated person

password.description: Plaintext password — hashed before storage, never persisted

scopeDescription.example: Authorized to submit applications on behalf of the organization

linkedByIdentityId.description: Ignored — linking administrator identity is derived from the authenticated session

activityHints.description: Optional activity hints supplied by the citizen

formSchema.description: Not rendered by the public start package; currently always null

attributes.description: Non-persistent applicant attributes used for guidance only

serviceVersionId.description: Optional service version id when checking against a pinned package

eligible.description: Preliminary guidance only; null when guidance cannot be derived

functionAuthorityRecordCode.description: Resolved Phase 4 function authority record code

functionAuthorityRecordName.description: Resolved Phase 4 function authority record name

servicePackVersionId.description: Target service pack version under governance review
